Issue.title: Cannot access the CCC Agency Portal login screen due to constant refreshing
Issue.description: When attempting to open the CCC Agency Portal, the page refreshes endlessly and never reaches the login screen.

Issue.title: Cannot clear browser cache/cookies due to organization-managed settings
Issue.description: The browser settings controls are grayed out with a message 'Settings are managed by your organization,' preventing the user from clearing history/cookies as instructed.

Solution.title: Clear browser history and cookies, then restart the browser
Solution.description: In the browser settings, clear history and cookies to remove potentially corrupted cache data, then close and reopen the browser before accessing the CCC Agency Portal again.

Solution.title: Have the local IT administrator clear the cache with admin rights
Solution.description: Because settings are locked by the organization, contact III Agency's local IT administrator to log in with admin privileges, clear the browser cache/cookies, and then retry accessing the portal; this cannot be done remotely by company support.
